p: to decline after many to wrest: Do that which is godly, though few favour it.
bring it back to him again: If we are bound to do good to our enemies beast, how much more to our enemy himself, Mt 5:44.
ass of him that hateth thee: If God commands us to help our enemy's donkey under his burden, will he suffer us to cast down our brethren with heavy burdens?
innocent and righteous slay thou not: Whether you are the magistrate or are commanded by the magistrate.
heart of a stranger: For since he is a stranger, his heart is sorrowful enough.
no mention of the name of: Neither by swearing by them, nor speaking of them, Ps 16:4, Eph 5:3.
unleavened bread: That is, Easter, in remembrance that the angel passed over and spared the Israelites, when he slew the first born of the Egyptians.
feast of harvest: Which is Whit Sunday, in token that the law was given 50 days after they departed from Egypt.
feast of ingathering: This is the feast of tabernacles, signifying that they lived for 40 years in the tents or the tabernacles in the wilderness.
leavened bread: No leavened bread will be in your house.
mother's milk: Meaning, that no fruit should be taken before just time: and by this all cruel and wanton appetites are controlled.
name is in him: I will give him my authority, and he will govern you in my name.
utterly overthrow them: God commands his own to not only not worship idols, but to destroy them.
bread: That is, all things necessary for this present life.
fear before thee: I will make them afraid of your coming and send my angel to destroy them, as in Ex 35:2.
of the Philistines: Called the Sea of Syria.
desert unto the: Of Arabia called desert.
